annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I want them on that boat.
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people living weighs more than one, even when the one is me.

annotations.ae_shared_affect: Seeing their fear, I'd be frightened right alongside them

annotations.sys_consistent_procedure: I use it even when it points somewhere painful.
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I'd be sobbing with them, their grief pulling mine up

annotations.ae_shared_affect: I feel their grief as it washes over them, and it becomes mine
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I keep going back and forth

annotations.sys_rule_justification: pick the plan that nobody has to be forced into
